correctness.rationale: The only possible terminal uncovered set in G=K_{2m} minus a perfect matching has 0 or 2 vertices. With k untouched forbidden pairs and s singles the D=binom(2k+s,2)-k admissible edges partition into binom(s,2),2ks,2k(k-1) transition classes; exact recurrence is correct. One tagged pair survives with limit m^2 p_m→3/4 using survival telescoping and two-tag suppression, hence m Pr(R_m=2)→3/4 and m E R_m→3/2. Independent labeled-state and reduced recurrence calculations matched m=2..7 including 0,1/5,8/65,1231/11375. Infinite limit follows from inequalities, not finite experiments.
